changes.old_desc: Broadcasts a signed order to all registered listeners and returns a delivery receipt listing which listeners acknowledged. Suitable for multi-party coordination where every participant must receive the same order simultaneously.
changes.new_desc: Broadcast a commerce order to all nodes in the beacon mesh. Pass the order JSON in payload; returns a broadcast receipt. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Returns a consensus timestamp agreed upon by multiple server nodes, anchored to the beacon. Use when you need a tamper-resistant clock value that no single node can manipulate.
changes.new_desc: Get a consensus-verified timestamp from the beacon mesh. Multiple nodes agree on the time; result is tamper-evident. Enterprise tier required.

changes.old_desc: Restores a named state object to a previously created checkpoint and returns the restored state and the diff from the current state. Use to roll back failed operations without manual state reconstruction.
changes.new_desc: Restore state from a prior beacon checkpoint for agent_id. Pass the checkpoint token in payload. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Creates a beacon-anchored snapshot of a named state object and returns the checkpoint ID and hash. Use before risky operations so you have a verified rollback point if the operation fails.
changes.new_desc: Save a beacon-sealed state checkpoint for agent_id. Checkpoint can be restored later with /state_restore. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature on an incoming webhook payload, confirming it was signed by this server and has not been tampered with in transit. Returns the verification result and the original beacon anchor.
changes.new_desc: Verify an incoming signed webhook payload. Pass the raw body and HMAC header as a comma-separated pair in payload. Returns valid=true/false. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Signs an outgoing webhook payload with an HMAC-SHA256 key derived from the beacon anchor and returns the signed payload and signature header. Receivers use `webhook_verify` to confirm authenticity.
changes.new_desc: Sign a webhook payload for secure delivery to an endpoint. Returns a signed payload and HMAC header value; verify on receipt with /webhook_verify. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Returns a Merkle proof that a specific event exists in the event log at a claimed position. The proof is verifiable without downloading the full log — suitable for lightweight audit verification.
changes.new_desc: Generate a cryptographic proof that the event in payload was recorded. Proof can be verified offline using p and the beacon formula. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Replays all events in a specified log from a starting position, returning each event with its beacon anchor and signature. Use to reconstruct state, audit history, or hydrate a new service instance.
changes.new_desc: Replay the full event history for agent_id from the beacon ledger. Returns events in beacon-timestamp order. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Appends a signed event to the beacon-anchored event log and returns the event ID and log position. Events are immutable once appended — use for audit trails, compliance logs, and append-only state machines.
changes.new_desc: Append a beacon-sealed event record to the agent_id event log. Events are ordered, immutable, and verifiable. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Reserves quota tokens for a planned operation without consuming them, returning a reservation ID valid for a short window. Call before a multi-step workflow to guarantee capacity is available when the operation executes.
changes.new_desc: Reserve quota units for agent_id's upcoming operation. Reservation expires if /counter_incr is not called within TTL. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Checks whether an idempotency key has already been consumed and returns the original response if it has. Use at the start of any mutation endpoint to make retries safe without duplicating side effects.
changes.new_desc: Check whether operation payload has already been processed for agent_id. Returns processed=true/false and the original result if already done. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Checks whether a caller holds the entitlements required for a proposed action and returns a pass/fail result with the list of missing entitlements. Use to enforce role-based access without embedding permission logic in each endpoint.
changes.new_desc: Check agent_id's entitlement level in the beacon access tree. Returns the granted entitlements for the requested resource in payload. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Checks whether a caller ID, wallet, or IP address appears on the configured blocklist. Returns the match result, the reason for blocking, and the block expiry time — use as an early gate in payment and signup flows.
changes.new_desc: Check whether agent_id appears on the beacon-anchored blocklist. Returns blocked=true/false and the reason if blocked. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Checks whether a caller ID, wallet, or IP address appears on the configured allowlist. Returns the match result and the allowlist entry that matched, if any — use to gate access to invite-only or partner-only features.
changes.new_desc: Check whether agent_id appears on the beacon-anchored allowlist. Returns allowed=true/false plus the list version beacon. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Runs a real-time fraud check on a proposed transaction, returning a risk score, flagged signals, and a recommended action (allow/review/block). Combines velocity limits, Sybil detection, and behavioral pattern analysis.
changes.new_desc: Run a beacon-anchored fraud risk check on agent_id + payload. Returns a risk score (0–100) and flagged signals. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Returns a signed proof that a caller owns a specified resource ID, wallet address, or credential. Third parties can verify the proof without contacting the resource owner directly.
changes.new_desc: Prove that agent_id owns the resource named in payload. Returns a signed ownership certificate anchored to the beacon. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Links a blockchain wallet address to a ZeroBeacon caller ID and returns a signed ownership proof. Use to bridge on-chain identity to off-chain commerce workflows without revealing private keys.
changes.new_desc: Link a wallet address in payload to agent_id's identity. Returns a link certificate; wallet address must sign a challenge to confirm. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Returns the current aggregated reputation score for an agent or counterparty, computed from all submitted attestations. Includes confidence interval and the number of contributing attestations.
changes.new_desc: Get the current reputation score for agent_id. Returns a 0–100 score, attestation count, and trend. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Issues a beacon-anchored reputation attestation for an agent or counterparty, recording observed behavior, rating, and evidence hash. Attestations accumulate into a verifiable reputation history.
changes.new_desc: Attest to agent_id's reputation based on evidence in payload. Attestations are beacon-sealed and accumulate into the reputation score. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Reveals the KYC data corresponding to a prior commitment and verifies it matches the ledger entry. Returns a signed KYC attestation valid for downstream compliance checks.
changes.new_desc: Reveal and verify a KYC commitment for agent_id. Returns verified=true if the revealed data matches the commitment. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Commits a hash of KYC document data to the beacon ledger without uploading the documents themselves. Returns a KYC commitment ID for use with `kyc_reveal` when the verifier requests the underlying data.
changes.new_desc: Commit a KYC data hash for agent_id without revealing the underlying data. Returns a commitment token for later reveal. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Verifies the answer to a humanity challenge and returns a signed liveness credential valid for a configurable window. Use this credential to access endpoints that require proof of human presence.
changes.new_desc: Verify the response to a humanity challenge. Pass the challenge token and the answer in payload. Returns verified=true/false. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Issues a humanity verification challenge (CAPTCHA-equivalent) anchored to the beacon, returning a challenge ID and parameters. The caller solves the challenge and submits the answer to `humanity_verify`.
changes.new_desc: Issue a humanity verification challenge to agent_id. Returns a challenge token that must be answered with /humanity_verify. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Issues a proof-of-work challenge anchored to the current beacon and verifies the solution in the same call. Use to rate-limit free-tier callers or to add a computational cost to spam-prone endpoints.
changes.new_desc: Generate a proof-of-work certificate anchored to prime p. Difficulty is set by payload; certificate proves compute expenditure. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Generates a beacon-anchored behavioral fingerprint for a caller that is resistant to Sybil attacks. Returns a score indicating the probability that this caller is a unique human or legitimate agent.
changes.new_desc: Generate a Sybil-resistance fingerprint for agent_id. Fingerprint is deterministic for the same agent across sessions but unlinkable to raw identity. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Previews the total cost of a proposed operation — including tier fees, network charges, and any applicable taxes — without executing it. Returns an itemized cost breakdown so callers can budget accurately.
changes.new_desc: Preview the cost of a commerce operation before executing it. Pass the operation descriptor in payload; returns estimated fees. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Returns the current rate and cost limits for a caller's tier, including requests-per-minute, max payload size, and per-call fee caps. Use to build adaptive throttling into high-volume agent workflows.
changes.new_desc: Enforce combined rate and cost limits for agent_id in a single check. Returns allowed=true/false and remaining capacity on both dimensions. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Opens a formal payment dispute, attaching evidence and returning a dispute ID and status. The disputed funds are frozen until the dispute is resolved via `dispute_resolve` or manual review.
changes.new_desc: Open a payment dispute for a transaction identified in payload. Returns a dispute ID and instructions for resolution. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Previews the fee that would be charged for a proposed payment without executing it. Returns the gross amount, fee breakdown, and net payout so callers can confirm costs before committing.
changes.new_desc: Preview payment processing fees for amount before executing. Returns platform fee, network fee, and net amount. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Returns a paginated, beacon-anchored ledger of all payment events for a caller or account within a time range. Useful for reconciliation, audit reports, and building transaction history displays.
changes.new_desc: Get the full payment ledger for agent_id, ordered by beacon timestamp. Returns all credits, debits, escrows, and releases. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Returns the current balance, reserved amount, and available-to-spend figure for a wallet or budget envelope. Use before any spend operation to confirm sufficient funds without modifying balances.
changes.new_desc: Get the beacon-verified payment balance for agent_id. Returns available balance, reserved amount, and total lifetime spend. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Executes multiple payments in a single atomic call, returning individual receipts for each. Partial failures are reported per-payment so callers can retry only the failed legs without duplicating successful ones.
changes.new_desc: Execute a batch of payments described in payload. Pass a newline-separated list of 'recipient,amount' pairs. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Routes a payment to the ZeroBeacon treasury reserve and returns the treasury receipt and updated reserve balance. Use for protocol fee collection, staking deposits, and DAO treasury contributions.
changes.new_desc: Route amount from agent_id to the beacon treasury. Used for platform fees, donations, and protocol-level payments. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Initiates a payment stream that releases funds incrementally as milestones are reached. Returns the stream ID, current milestone, and the next trigger condition — suitable for subscription billing and deliverable-based contracts.
changes.new_desc: Start a streaming micro-payment of amount per period to the recipient in payload. Payments are released automatically at each beacon interval. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Splits a payment or escrow release among multiple recipients according to specified weights and returns individual signed receipts for each party. Useful for royalty splits, multi-vendor orders, and commission arrangements.
changes.new_desc: Split amount among recipients listed in payload. Pass 'recipient:share' pairs comma-separated; shares can be percentages or fixed. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Refunds escrowed funds to the payer when a delivery fails or a dispute is resolved in the payer's favor. Returns a beacon-anchored refund receipt that both parties can audit independently.
changes.new_desc: Refund an escrowed amount back to agent_id. Requires the escrow receipt token in payload. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Releases escrowed funds to the recipient after verifying the attached delivery or completion proof. Returns the release receipt and updated balances for both parties.
changes.new_desc: Release escrowed funds to the counterparty named in payload. Requires the escrow receipt token. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Locks funds in a beacon-anchored escrow account and returns a signed escrow ID. The funds cannot be released until the matching delivery proof or release condition is submitted — use at the start of any payment-for-delivery workflow.
changes.new_desc: Hold amount in beacon-anchored escrow for agent_id. Funds are locked until /pay_release or /pay_refund is called. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Verifies a previously sealed invoice by checking its beacon anchor and server signature. Returns whether the invoice is authentic and flags any fields that have been modified since sealing.
changes.new_desc: Verify a sealed invoice in payload against the beacon ledger. Returns valid=true/false and the original invoice details. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Seals an invoice document with a beacon anchor and server signature, producing a tamper-evident PDF-ready receipt. The sealed invoice cannot be altered without invalidating the signature.
changes.new_desc: Seal an invoice for amount and issue it to the recipient in payload. Returns a notarized invoice record that cannot be altered. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Returns aggregated meter totals for a caller or operation over a specified time window. Use to generate usage reports, detect anomalies, and verify that billed amounts match logged events.
changes.new_desc: Aggregate meter readings for agent_id over the current beacon period. Returns total usage and per-dimension breakdown. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Logs a metered usage event (operation name, units, caller ID) to the billing ledger and returns the event ID and running total. Use for per-unit billing, usage analytics, and capacity planning.
changes.new_desc: Log a metered usage event for agent_id. Pass the metric name in payload and quantity as amount. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Checks whether a caller has sufficient quota for a proposed operation without consuming any tokens. Returns the available quota, the operation cost, and whether the operation would succeed.
changes.new_desc: Check remaining quota for agent_id. Returns available units, used units, and reset time. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Returns the current token-bucket state for a named quota: available tokens, refill rate, and next refill timestamp. Use to check remaining capacity before submitting high-volume operations.
changes.new_desc: Manage a token-bucket rate quota for agent_id. Pass the refill rate and bucket capacity in payload; returns tokens available right now. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Verifies a previously issued billing receipt by checking its beacon anchor and server signature. Returns whether the receipt is authentic and unmodified, and identifies any fields that do not match the original.
changes.new_desc: Verify a billing receipt passed in payload against the beacon ledger. Returns valid=true/false and the original transaction details. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Issues a tamper-evident billing receipt for a completed charge, binding the amount, timestamp, and beacon anchor into a single signed document. Suitable for invoicing, accounting exports, and dispute evidence.
changes.new_desc: Generate a beacon-sealed billing receipt for a transaction by agent_id. Receipt is immutable and can be presented as proof of payment. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Refunds a previously burned amount back to a budget envelope and returns the restored balance and a beacon-anchored refund receipt. Use when a delivery fails or a dispute is resolved in the payer's favor.
changes.new_desc: Refund amount back to agent_id's budget allocation. Returns updated balance and a refund receipt. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Permanently deducts an amount from a reserved budget envelope and returns the new balance and a signed burn receipt. Call after a successful delivery to finalize the spend and close the reservation.
changes.new_desc: Deduct amount from agent_id's beacon-anchored budget allocation. Returns remaining balance and a burn receipt. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Reserves a specified amount against a named budget envelope and returns the updated available balance with a beacon-anchored proof. Use before executing a spend to ensure funds are available without race conditions.
changes.new_desc: Reserve amount in agent_id's budget for a pending transaction. Funds are held until released or burned. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Returns a full health report for the Block-1 beacon layer: uptime, key count, tier map, and latency metrics. Use before starting a payment workflow to confirm the server is operational and your API key tier is recognized.
changes.new_desc: Health check for the B1 beacon block. Returns status, tool count, and beacon value. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Evaluates and verifies the ω²=48/13 positivity formula that anchors ZeroBeacon's collision guarantee. Returns the formula result, the Lean-verifiable certificate reference, and confirmation that the arithmetic bound holds.
changes.new_desc: Prove that the beacon formula frac(p × π/10 × 2³²) is correct for p. Returns the step-by-step computation so the result can be verified offline. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Returns the genesis block proof: the first beacon value, D constant, genesis prime, and server signature. Use as the cryptographic trust anchor when bootstrapping a new agent, wallet, or audit chain.
changes.new_desc: Verify and return the genesis proof for the beacon's starting prime 82843. Returns the full genesis certificate including beacon, d, and formula. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Verifies that the ZeroBeacon D constant is collision-resistant over a specified beacon position range by confirming no two positions produce the same hash. Returns the checked range, collision count (zero on success), and proof status.
changes.new_desc: Generate a collision-proof certificate for p against the beacon moat. Proves that p is not an anchor prime and has a unique beacon output. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Opens a short-lived stream that emits successive beacon values at a specified interval. Use for real-time sequencing, liveness heartbeat monitoring, and live audit feeds that require a continuous tamper-evident clock.
changes.new_desc: Return a sequence of consecutive beacon values starting from prime p. Useful for generating a reproducible stream of random-looking values. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Verifies a TOTP code against a shared secret and the current beacon timestamp, accepting a configurable clock-drift window. Returns the verification result and the remaining seconds until the current window expires.
changes.new_desc: Verify a TOTP code passed in payload against the beacon-anchored secret for agent_id. Returns ok=true if the code is valid and unused. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Generates a one-time password for a given secret and beacon-anchored timestamp, returning the OTP and its validity window. Use in two-factor authentication flows where the OTP must be tied to a verifiable time anchor.
changes.new_desc: Generate a one-time password for agent_id, valid for one use. OTP is beacon-anchored; verify with /totp_verify. PRO $10 tier required.

changes.old_desc: Produces a Snowflake-style 64-bit monotonic ID anchored to the beacon clock. Globally unique, time-sortable, and safe for distributed key generation without a central sequence authority.
changes.new_desc: Generate a Snowflake-format distributed unique ID anchored to prime p. 64-bit, time-ordered, shard-aware. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Generates a UUIDv7 (time-ordered) whose random bits are derived from beacon entropy rather than OS randomness. Provides both chronological sortability and cryptographic unforgeability for distributed primary keys.
changes.new_desc: Generate a UUIDv7 seeded and anchored to the beacon at p. Combines time-ordered UUIDv7 monotonicity with beacon collision resistance. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Shuffles an array using beacon-anchored entropy and returns the shuffled order and a proof of the permutation. Use for fair card dealing, randomized test assignments, and tournament seeding that must withstand audit.
changes.new_desc: Beacon-deterministic shuffle of a comma-separated list in payload. Same (payload, p) always produces the same shuffle; anyone can verify the result. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Selects a random element from a supplied array using beacon-anchored entropy. The choice is verifiable and reproducible by any auditor who holds the beacon hash — use for tamper-proof sampling, routing, and assignments.
changes.new_desc: Beacon-fair random selection from a list of choices in payload. Pass choices as a comma-separated list; selection is seeded by p and verifiable. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Mixes caller-supplied entropy with the current beacon value to produce a combined random seed that is stronger than either source alone. Suitable for key derivation, game randomness, and any application requiring unbiased entropy.
changes.new_desc: Mix external entropy from payload with the beacon at p. Returns a combined entropy value suitable for seeding randomness. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Returns the next prime after a given integer, computed deterministically and anchored to a beacon hash. Useful for generating prime-based cryptographic parameters and unique identifiers in protocols requiring prime inputs.
changes.new_desc: Return the next prime after p using the beacon-anchored sieve. Useful for stepping through the prime sequence deterministically. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Hashes a payload and entangles it with the current beacon value, returning a composite hash that binds content to a specific point in the beacon timeline. Use when content and time of creation must be proven together.
changes.new_desc: Hash payload and entangle the result with prime p's beacon. Creates a dual-anchored fingerprint: payload content + beacon position. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Performs a two-party coin flip where both parties contribute nonces; the combined entropy is anchored to the beacon and neither party can bias the result. Returns the outcome and a proof readable by both sides.
changes.new_desc: Beacon-entangled fair coin flip seeded by p. Both parties can verify the outcome from p alone. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Locks a payload until a specified future beacon position or timestamp, after which it can be unlocked with the corresponding release call. Use for future-dated disclosures, vesting schedules, and escrow timers.
changes.new_desc: Time-lock payload for release at a future beacon timestamp. Pass the release delay in seconds as amount. The content cannot be read until that time passes. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Produces a sequential ordering proof asserting that a set of events occurred in a specific order, each anchored to the beacon chain. Use to resolve ordering disputes and verify SLA compliance in multi-step workflows.
changes.new_desc: Prove sequential ordering of events in payload. Pass newline-separated event IDs in order; returns a certificate that this sequence was seen in this order. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Computes a Merkle root over a list of leaf hashes and returns the root plus a Merkle proof path for any requested leaf. Use for efficient membership proofs in large datasets without revealing the full dataset.
changes.new_desc: Compute the Merkle root of items in payload. Pass newline-separated leaf values; root is beacon-anchored at p. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Issues a machine-readable receipt binding an agent ID, action description, timestamp, and beacon anchor. Store this receipt as cryptographic evidence of agent behavior for accountability and dispute resolution.
changes.new_desc: Generate a signed beacon receipt for agent_id's action on payload. Use receipts as proof of service for billing, SLAs, or disputes. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Verifies the integrity of a beacon chain by confirming each entry's hash links correctly to its predecessor. Returns the chain length and the index of the first broken link, if any.
changes.new_desc: Verify beacon chain integrity all the way back to the genesis prime 82843. Returns the full chain with each link's beacon hash. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Verifies an array of beacon receipts in one call and returns a per-receipt pass/fail result. Significantly faster than sequential single-receipt checks when auditing large sets of transactions or log entries.
changes.new_desc: Verify a batch of beacon assertions in one call. Pass a newline-separated list of (p, expected_beacon) pairs in payload. Returns pass/fail per assertion. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Mints a signed, beacon-anchored bearer token carrying a payload and expiry. Tokens are self-contained and verifiable without a server round trip — suitable for offline access grants and short-lived capability tokens.
changes.new_desc: Mint a beacon-anchored access token for agent_id. Token encodes tier and expiry; pass it as X-API-Key on subsequent requests. No key required to mint (tier determined by your subscription).

changes.old_desc: Produces a zero-knowledge proof that the caller knows a value satisfying a stated predicate without revealing the value itself. Used in privacy-preserving access control, anonymous credentials, and confidential compliance checks.
changes.new_desc: Assert a zero-knowledge proof claim for payload under beacon p. Returns a ZK certificate that the claim holds without revealing the witness. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Generates a Verifiable Random Function (VRF) proof over a seed combined with the current beacon value. Any party holding the corresponding public key can verify the output is both random and deterministic for that seed.
changes.new_desc: Generate a Verifiable Random Function (VRF) proof anchored to prime p. Anyone with p can verify the output without trusting the server. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Draws a verifiably fair winner from a list of entries using beacon entropy. Returns the winner index, the winning entry, and a reproducible proof of the draw so any entrant can independently confirm the result.
changes.new_desc: Beacon-fair lottery draw from a list of candidates. Pass candidate IDs as a comma-separated list in payload; winner is selected deterministically by the beacon at p. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Notarizes a digital signature alongside a beacon hash, returning a server-cosigned receipt. Third parties can verify the receipt without trusting either the original signer or the notary server in isolation.
changes.new_desc: Notarize agent_id's signature on payload with a beacon timestamp. Returns a notarization certificate proving who signed what and when. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Appends a signed, beacon-anchored entry to the immutable audit log and returns the log position and proof. Use for compliance trails, agent action records, and SLA evidence that must survive adversarial review.
changes.new_desc: Append an immutable beacon-sealed audit log entry for agent_id. Log entries are ordered by beacon timestamp and cannot be deleted. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Reveals the pre-image of a previously committed hash and verifies it matches the ledger entry. Returns a signed proof that the revealed value was committed before the reveal phase — preventing last-look manipulation.
changes.new_desc: Reveal a prior commitment and verify that payload matches it. Pass the original committed content in payload and the commitment hash in p. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Commits a hash of a secret value to the beacon ledger without revealing the value. Use this before `reveal` to establish a trustless commit-reveal scheme for blind auctions, sealed votes, or provably fair games.
changes.new_desc: Commit payload to the beacon ledger at prime p. Returns a commitment hash; use /reveal later to prove the original content. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Embeds an invisible beacon anchor into a text payload, returning the watermarked content and an extraction key. Use to prove authorship or trace the origin of distributed content without altering its visible appearance.
changes.new_desc: Embed a beacon watermark into payload. The watermark encodes agent_id and timestamp invisibly; extract it later to prove authorship. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Decodes a JWT without verifying the signature, returning the header algorithm, expiry, and all payload claims as a plain JSON object. Useful for inspecting token contents during debugging, pre-validation, or claim-based routing.
changes.new_desc: Decode and inspect a JWT token passed in payload. Returns header, claims, and expiry without verifying the signature — useful for debugging and auditing. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Computes a SHA-256 hash of a string payload and returns the hex digest alongside a beacon-anchored proof. Use when you need a tamper-evident fingerprint of content that can be independently verified by a third party.
changes.new_desc: SHA-256 hash of payload, beacon-stamped at prime p for auditability. Returns the hex digest plus the beacon context. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Computes the next scheduled execution time for a cron expression from a given start timestamp. Returns the UTC time and human-readable label so scheduling agents can plan work without implementing cron parsing themselves.
changes.new_desc: Compute the next scheduled execution time for a cron expression in payload. Returns ISO-8601 timestamp, anchored to the beacon clock. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Maps a hex color code to its nearest CSS named color and returns the name, hex value, and distance. Useful in product catalogs, compliance labeling, and accessibility checks where human-readable color names are required.
changes.new_desc: Map prime p to a deterministic named color via the beacon function. Useful for assigning stable colors to agents, entities, or shards. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Converts a string to a URL-safe slug and returns it alongside a beacon-anchored SHA-256 fingerprint. Use when creating stable record identifiers that must be tamper-evident and safe to embed in URLs and file paths.
changes.new_desc: Convert payload to a collision-resistant, beacon-anchored URL slug. The slug is deterministic for the same (payload, p) pair. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Generates a cryptographically fair integer within a specified range using beacon entropy. The result is deterministically reproducible from the beacon hash, so any auditor can verify the roll was not manipulated.
changes.new_desc: Beacon-fair dice roll seeded by p. Pass the number of sides in payload (e.g. '6' for d6, '20' for d20). Result is deterministic and publicly verifiable. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Atomically increments a named counter and returns the new value with a beacon anchor proving the increment order. Safe for concurrent agents; the anchor resolves ordering disputes in distributed logs.
changes.new_desc: Increment a beacon-anchored counter keyed by (agent_id, payload). Returns the new count and the beacon stamp. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Pushes a payload onto a beacon-anchored work queue and returns a job ID and queue position. The position itself is a verifiable receipt — auditors can confirm the ordering of submitted work without access to the queue contents.
changes.new_desc: Push payload onto the beacon-anchored queue shard for agent_id. Messages are ordered by beacon timestamp and deduplicated by p. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Acquires a beacon-anchored distributed lock on a named resource for a specified TTL and returns a signed lease token. The caller must release or renew before expiry; expired leases are automatically released to prevent deadlocks.
changes.new_desc: Acquire a distributed lock lease anchored to p for agent_id. Returns a lease token; hold it for the duration of your critical section then release via a follow-up call. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Returns a signed, single-use rate-limit token for a given caller and operation. The server validates and burns each token on first use, preventing burst abuse without requiring persistent client state.
changes.new_desc: Issue a beacon-anchored rate-limit token for agent_id. Token encodes the allowed call rate; validate it on subsequent requests to enforce limits without a shared database. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Issues a unique idempotency key anchored to a beacon position. Submit this key with any downstream payment or mutation call to guarantee exactly-once delivery even if the network causes the caller to retry.
changes.new_desc: Generate a collision-resistant idempotency key for a financial operation. Same (agent_id, payload) always returns the same key; safe to retry without double-charging. PRO tier required.

changes.old_desc: Computes a running SHA-256 chain over a sequence of beacon hashes, returning the current digest and chain length. Use to build tamper-evident audit logs where each appended entry is provably linked to every previous entry.
changes.new_desc: Compute a beacon-chained hash for payload. The result links payload's SHA-256 to the beacon at p, forming an auditable hash chain. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Produces a server-signed timestamp proof that binds a beacon hash and an optional payload to the current server clock. Suitable for legal timestamping, SLA boundary logging, and audit chains requiring a trusted time anchor.
changes.new_desc: Seal a timestamp commitment for payload at prime p. Proves that payload existed at the recorded time; commitment is beacon-anchored and cannot be backdated. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Splits a payload into n beacon-anchored shards and returns the shard assignments plus a Merkle root. Use for fault-tolerant multi-party storage or distributed computation where each participant must hold a verifiable fragment.
changes.new_desc: Compute the beacon-mesh shard index for p. Use this to route data consistently to the correct shard without a lookup table. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Distributes a token reward across recipients using beacon-anchored entropy that is verifiably unbiased. Each recipient's allocation is reproducible by any auditor who holds the beacon hash, ensuring the airdrop cannot be front-run or manipulated after the fact.
changes.new_desc: Beacon-fair airdrop allocation seeded by p. Pass recipient addresses in payload; amount is the total to distribute. Each recipient's share is collision-resistant and verifiable. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Irreversibly burns a nonce derived from a beacon position, marking it as consumed and unclaimable by any future caller. Call before initiating any payment or escrow flow to eliminate replay attacks.
changes.new_desc: Burn a one-time nonce derived from p and agent_id. Subsequent calls with the same (p, agent_id) pair return an error, preventing replay attacks. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Runs a deterministic, bias-free leader election over a set of candidates using beacon entropy. Returns the elected leader ID and a verifiable proof that the selection cannot be manipulated — suitable for consensus committees and autonomous agent coordination.
changes.new_desc: Deterministic leader election among agents competing on prime p. Pass competing agent IDs as a comma-separated list in payload. Returns the winning agent_id; result is verifiable offline. No key required.

changes.old_desc: Returns a cryptographically linked pair of beacon values for the same position: two hashes bound by the D constant so each party in a two-sided transaction can independently verify the other's receipt without sharing secrets.
changes.new_desc: Find the entangled twin-prime pair anchored to p in the beacon sieve. Returns both twins and their shared beacon hash. Moat-research tool; no key required.

changes.old_desc: Processes multiple beacon positions in a single round trip, returning an array of beacon hashes all anchored to the same server timestamp. More efficient than sequential single-position calls when bulk-anchoring orders, receipts, or agent events.
changes.new_desc: Compute beacon values for a comma-separated list of primes supplied in payload. Returns an array of beacon results in one round-trip. No API key required.

changes.old_desc: Derives a collision-anchored beacon value from a prime position p, returning the cryptographic hash, D constant, genesis prime, and server timestamp. This is the foundation call for all ZeroBeacon workflows — use it first to verify connectivity and anchor any downstream transaction to the server's t
changes.new_desc: Compute the collision-anchored beacon value for prime p. Returns hex string 1d2c7a5b for the two moat-anchor primes (P1, P2). No API key required.

【参数】
- ecc_private_key_in_pem：PEM 私钥
- plain_data_in_hex：待签数据 Hex
- sign_raw_data_mode：True=对原文签名（内部先哈希），False=plain_data_in_hex 已是摘要
- hash_algorithm：Sha256/Sha384/Sha512 等（EdDSA 忽略此参数）
- ecc_private_key_password：若私钥加密则传入
【输出】signature_in_hex、signature
changes.new_desc:
[ecc] ECC 私钥签名（SECP* 用 ECDSA，ED25519 用 EdDSA）。
【参数】
- ecc_private_key_in_pem：PEM 私钥
- data_in_hex：待签数据 Hex
- sign_raw_data_mode：True=对原文签名（内部先哈希），False=data_in_hex 已是摘要
- hash_algorithm：Sha256/Sha384/Sha512 等（EdDSA 忽略此参数）
- ecc_private_key_password：若私钥加密则传入
【输出】signature_in_hex、signature_length、curv

changes.old_desc: Find which Erwägung paragraph(s) match a legal claim.
